stability.metric: adjusted Rand agreement between the original partition and the partition after reversing observable report order and mapping labels back

review_policy.metric: review queue items divided by emitted destinations plus individually unresolved reports

geographic_constraint.status: illustrative synthetic operational guardrail; not expert validated

matched_composition_constraints.scope: calibration-seed mean relative to selected product configuration
matched_composition_constraints.joint_selection_rule: choose the objective-best operationally feasible product configuration for which every declared non-product composition family has at least one operationally feasible density/degree match; then select each comparator within its matched feasible set

constraint_aggregation: per-seed extrema; every seed must satisfy each applicable guardrail
failure_policy: retain every failed and infeasible configuration; never relax a constraint after evaluation release
